landmarks.name: The Core
landmarks.purpose: Central structure, the map's centerpiece and primary sightline-breaker, restructured in v3 so the Rocket Launcher pad is buildable at MID level per GDD 2.6. Base drum x[16,24] y[16,24] z[0,4] is solid; its roof at height 4 is the mid-level rocket terrace and rocket_node (20,17,4) stands on its south side. Spire x[18,22] y[18,22] z[4,9] rises from the roof center, breaking the mid-level north-south line; its flat top at height 9 is a grapple perch (Core Top, GP5/GP6). Four full-height corner pylons x[15,17] y[15,17] z[0,9], x[23,25] y[15,17] z[0,9], x[15,17] y[23,25] z[0,9], x[23,25] y[23,25] z[0,9] carry the diagonal occlusion between mid and upper spawns; they deliberately embed 1 m into the base drum's corners (union geometry).

grapple_note: Grappleshot range is 20 m (GDD 2.5 / Appendix A). Every anchor above is within 13 m 3D of its named ground approach, so none is decoration. Upper positions each carry >= 2 anchors on distinct approach vectors: Gantry West (GP1,GP2), Gantry East (GP3,GP4), Core Top (GP5,GP6). GP7/GP8 serve the mid level as attack routes, above the requirement.

Nothing physical changed. The four chest crates remain; their extents come from blockout_profile.json cover_dims_m by schema design (point + height_class is the cover vocabulary).

sightlines.notes: Static slab test (rung 1, arena_plan.py semantics: both endpoints at +1.7 m eye height, all 20 named solid AABBs). BLOCKED spawn pairs with an interior proof point: floor diagonals SP1-SP4 / SP2-SP3 (45.25 m) pass through base_drum, e.g. (20,20,1.7) is interior, leaving 16.97 m corner-to-drum runs; the four edge corridors (32 m) are cut by their named barricade/stack, e.g. (20,4,1.7) interior to South Barricade, leaving 14.0 m spawn-to-face runs; SP5-SP6 (14 m) is cut by the spire, midpoint (20,20,5.7) interior; the four adjacent mid-upper pairs are cut by pylons: SP5-SP7 at (16,16.5,7.7) in pylon_sw, SP5-SP8 at (24,16.5,7.7) in pylon_se, SP6-SP7 at (16,23.5,7.7) in pylon_nw, SP6-SP8 at (24,23.5,7.7) in pylon_ne; the four long ground-upper diagonals are cut by pylons: SP1-SP8 at (23.2,16.8,8.1) in pylon_se, SP2-SP7 at (16.8,16.8,8.1) in pylon_sw, SP3-SP8 at (23.2,23.2,8.1) in pylon_ne, SP4-SP7 at (16.8,23.2,8.1) in pylon_nw. OPEN pairs (no named solid on the eye line), all under the 35 m cap: SP7-SP8 16.00 m; SP1-SP5, SP2-SP5, SP3-SP6, SP4-SP6 18.79 m; SP1-SP7, SP2-SP8, SP3-SP7, SP4-SP8 19.60 m; SP1-SP6, SP2-SP6, SP3-SP5, SP4-SP5 28.30 m. Longest statically-open spawn-to-spawn line: 28.30 m (was 19.60 m in v2; the four 28.30 m pairs opened when the drum dropped to height 4 for the rocket terrace, and each passes within 0.31 m above a stair volume top - real ramp geometry may occlude them; see doubts). This enumerates spawn-to-spawn lines only; it is not a sweep of every possible line in the blockout.

hazards: The Gantry has no railing on any edge - an 8 m fall to ground is possible without stairs (which no longer reach it) or a grapple descent.
The Core roof terrace, both mezzanine decks, and the spire/pylon tops are unrailed; 4-9 m drops throughout the map center.
The rocket terrace is a deliberate exposure trade: contesting the pad at (20,17,4) stands you on the map's most visible mid-level surface, overlooked by both Gantry segments and Core Top.
doubts: Rocket legibility (rung 3): confirm in the editor walkthrough that the pad at (20,17,4) reads from all three levels - near-south ground is blind to it by the drum face (a commit-to-see trade) and the spire hides it from due north. If the walkthrough finds a level with NO natural sighting position, that is a v4 revision, not a builder adjustment.

The four 28.30 m open pairs (SP1-SP6, SP2-SP6, SP3-SP5, SP4-SP5) each pass 0.31 m above a stair volume top - when the stair boxes become real ramps at rung 3, these lines may in fact be occluded; re-measure in the editor rather than trusting either answer from coordinates.

5 m LOS-breakage per spawn is an editor-rung check across the board: SP1-SP4 rely on the chest crates at 4.24 m breaking standing eye-height LoS; SP5/SP6 rely on the spire face at exactly 5.0 m; SP7/SP8 have NO static breaker at gantry eye height beyond dropping off the deck. If the walkthrough finds spawn-camping viable, v4 adds gantry parapets.

All 8 ground-mid spawn pairs are statically open (18.79-28.30 m): SP5/SP6 are deliberate overwatch spawns and their scoring_hints should keep the scorer from using them under fire - accepted under R6; the walkthrough judges whether the deck edges need a chest parapet in v4.

Grapple-only integrity (rung 3): confirm no walkable/jumpable path reaches z=8 - specifically the 1 m horizontal gap from pylon tops (z=9) to the Gantry and the 4 m gap from Core Top. Also confirm the stair volumes, once ramped, do not accidentally serve z=8.

Grapple anchor validity (rung 3, carried from v2): whether the Core/Gantry surfaces at each GP register as valid Grappleshot targets is a gameplay question, as is each anchor's reachability from two genuinely distinct approach lanes.

Mutual visibility beyond spawn-to-spawn (oblique lines, mid-fight positions) is not swept by the static test; the rung-3 walkthrough plus the reachability sweep (BP07 step 4) remain the verification, per R7.
Spire top and pylon tops are freeform-grapple perches - confirm at the walkthrough that they do not become dominant camp positions; only Core Top is sanctioned with anchors (GP5/GP6).
